title: Foundry Dyad IR
description: The formal, deterministically-compilable intermediate representation an architecture role emits. A flat list of nodes carrying two overlaid graphs: an ownership TREE (via `owner`) and a dependency DAG (via `requires`). Every node is a dyad: a doer implements `provides`; an independent tester verifies it against `acceptance`, whose mandate is owned by the node's parent (never the node itself).

ir_version.description: Foundry IR wire-format version. Unsupported versions fail closed.

language.description: Default implementation language for leaves that don't override it (a Piston-supported runtime, e.g. 'python', 'typescript').

root.description: Id of the root node. Its `owner` MUST be null; its `acceptance.mandate_owner` is 'spec' (the Chairman's top-level acceptance).

kind.description: leaf = the doer writes real code. integrator = the doer writes glue composing this node's children.

owner.description: Parent (manager) node id — the ownership TREE edge. null only for `root`. The owner authors this node's acceptance mandate.

provides.description: The single interface this node promises UPWARD to its owner. Held stable across interface-preserving re-architecture.

requires.description: Interfaces this node consumes. Each entry is a dependency-DAG edge (this node depends_on ref.node). Must reference an interface actually provided by an existing node.

acceptance.description: The parent-owned, black-box acceptance suite the tester runs via Piston. Verifies `provides` (and, for integrators, composed behavior) — NOT the internals.

types.description: Optional named type/shape definitions the operations reference.

properties.description: Behavioral contract clauses (NOT just the type signature) — the leaky-interface guard. e.g. 'idempotent', 'output matches ^[a-z0-9-]+$'.

interface.description: Name of that node's provided interface.

language.description: A Piston-supported runtime the doer writes in (e.g. 'python', 'typescript').

write_target.description: Repo-relative path/dir the doer may WRITE (the sandbox write scope). The doer's read-set is derived by the compiler = each required node's write_target, mounted read-only.

entrypoint.description: Optional file within write_target that exports `provides`.

children.description: Ids of the child nodes this integrator composes. These are the ownership-TREE children (each child's `owner` must equal this node's id).

write_target.description: Repo-relative path/dir for the glue/composition code the integrator's doer writes.

composition.description: Optional prose/pseudocode describing how children compose to satisfy `provides` (e.g. 'slugify(s) = hyphenate(trim(lower(s)))').

mandate_owner.description: Id of the node that OWNS this acceptance mandate (the parent), or 'spec' for the root. Integrity rule: never equal to the node's own id — the doer cannot author its own exam.

language.description: Piston runtime the acceptance suite executes under.

cases.description: Deterministic, executable test cases (LeetCode-style). Each is judged pass/fail by Piston.

properties.description: Optional property-based invariants to fuzz (behavioral contract, beyond fixed cases).

perf.description: Optional LeetCode-style resource limits enforced by Piston.

harness.description: Optional full test-body source (for cases that need setup/state beyond call/expect).
